text: 你听见肉垫脚步的轻响，转身举起步枪。一只长着剑齿的巨大狮子跃上你上方的岩柱，张开大口扑来。
向剑齿猫开一枪。如果伯纳德有武器，他也可以开一枪。如果你们任意一人通过困难难度的 DEX 检定，就可以再开第二枪。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 611
text: You hear the soft lope of padded feet and whirl your rifle around. A monstrous lion with saber-toothed fangs springs to the top of a rock chimney above you and leaps, jaws wide.
Take one shot at the saber-toothed cat. Bernard may also take a shot if he is armed. If either of you succeeds with a Hard DEX roll, you may squeeze off a second shot.
